zh-Hant.title: 微縮台灣
zh-Hant.subtitle: 走到景點，收藏一座小島
zh-Hant.description:
微縮台灣把台灣做成一座可以收藏的小島。

走到景點、用定位打卡，就能解鎖那個地方的可愛微縮模型：台北 101、九份老街、日月潭、太魯閣、蘭嶼⋯⋯全台 130 個景點，北中南東都有。

・地圖上看自己走過哪裡、還有哪些沒去
・收藏後可以放大看模型細節
・主畫面 Widget 每天輪播一個收藏，顯示收集進度
・走到景點附近時，鎖定畫面會提醒你可以打卡

適合喜歡旅行、喜歡收集、想把台灣走一遍的人。
zh-Hant.releaseNotes: 第一個版本：全台 130 個景點、淺色與深色主題、模型放大檢視、主畫面 Widget。
zh-Hant.promoText: 走到景點就解鎖一座微縮模型，把台灣收進口袋。

en-US.title: Islandia: Collect Taiwan
en-US.subtitle: Collect Taiwan, spot by spot
en-US.description:
Islandia turns Taiwan into an island you can collect.

Walk to a landmark, check in with your location, and unlock a cute miniature diorama of that place: Taipei 101, Jiufen, Sun Moon Lake, Taroko, Orchid Island and more. 130 spots across the north, centre, south and east.

• See on the map where you have been and what is left
• Zoom into every diorama you have collected
• A home-screen widget rotates through your collection and shows your progress
• A Live Activity reminds you when a spot is close enough to check in

Made for travellers and collectors who want to walk the whole island.
en-US.releaseNotes: First release: 130 spots across Taiwan, light and dark themes, zoomable dioramas, home-screen widget.
en-US.promoText: Walk to a landmark, unlock its miniature. Put Taiwan in your pocket.

review.notes:
Islandia is a collection game: you unlock a miniature diorama of a Taiwan landmark by checking in with your location while you are within the spot's check-in radius. Reviewers outside Taiwan can't reach a spot, so the app has a Try mode that any user can open.

To try the full flow:
1. Finish the short intro (allowing location is optional).
2. Open the ME tab (rightmost) and tap "Start trying" on the Try mode card, then confirm.
3. The app switches to a sample passport with 4 models and opens Explore, where a "Simulated location" card lists sample places. "Taipei Xinyi" is preselected.
4. Open Taipei 101 (marked "In range") and tap "Collect": the unlock moment plays; tap "Add to collection" and the 5th free model joins the passport.
5. Go back, open Elephant Mountain (also "In range") and collect it the same way: past the free five a new model arrives sealed and the paywall offers the one-time purchase "Islandia Full" (com.airnoir.islandia.full). It can be bought or restored with a sandbox account; buying it opens every sealed model.
6. Tap "End try mode" on the ME tab (or the banner on the World tab): the sample passport is deleted and the user's own passport comes back.

Sign in with Apple / Google is optional and only backs up the passport; the app works fully without an account. Location is used only while the app is open; it is never stored on our servers or sent to the weather service. Photos attached to spots stay on the device.
